run_opt_diff_cli: run the opt-diff CLI to compare two optimization record YAML files and generate a diff output
compare_optimization_records: compare two directories of LLVM optimization record files and produce added/removed remarks
generate_opt_diff_yaml: generate a YAML diff file marking Added True for new remarks and Added False for removed remarks
split_large_opt_diff: split a large optimization diff into multiple output files using the --max-size argument
run_parallel_opt_diff: run the opt-diff tool with parallel job processing via the --jobs argument
